method: perturb.py flips logic: flip = the chosen key differs from the original order's, counted on the questions answered in both orders (perturb.py skips non-ok requests); yn counts only the yes/no questions. 'own' = each system's answered set (= perturb.py, checked against the GPU box's flips.json); 'common' = the requests every E4 system answered (status ok) in orig and in the variant, used for the paired differences. Accuracy vs `expected` (top-1, no accepted sets) over ALL questions, unanswered = wrong. Last line per id. CIs: stratified cluster bootstrap, requests resampled inside each benchmark, questions of a request together, B=2000 seed 0, same draws for every system and variant (paired).
